ev.q: An expansive, breathtaking open world MMORPG
The need for quick reactions and precise control will keep you enthralled
You grind for 300 hours so you can grind slightly more efficiently
farm 1000 mobs per week to fail gear enhancement
endless grinds and almost endless quests
fight alongside friends to siege and conquer castles
train in professions such as fishing, trading, crafting, cooking, and more
There is no content in the game
the game incentivizes you to keep your game on 24/7
used the money I made to enhance gear
